messages:
claire: Heads up-- auditor Rowan asked for a compact evidence package tying the recent RBAC change to KMS decrypt activity for SOC2. Need: PR, approval ticket, sanitized CloudTrail snippets, KMS rotation log, SIEM alert trace, and a rollback demo. Who can own?

ben: I can own the runbook + PR links. We'll include a manifest.md that maps control IDs to files.

"auditor_rowan": Thanks  please ensure artifacts are replayable (sanitized) and include exact test commands for the rollback demo. We need to see Decrypt success before change and AccessDenied after revert.

lila: I'll produce the Splunk query and a jq sanitization script. Draft Splunk: 
```splunk
index=aws_cloudtrail eventName IN (Decrypt,GenerateDataKey) requestParameters.keyId="arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999999999999:key/abcd-ef01"
| table _time userIdentity.principalId eventName requestParameters.keyId errorMessage
| sort _time
```

lila: Sanitization (jq) example:
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2024-11-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2024-11-07T23:59:59Z --query 'Events[].CloudTrailEvent' > raw.json
jq 'map({eventTime:.eventTime, principal:.userIdentity.arn, eventName:.eventName, keyId:.requestParameters.keyId})' raw.json > sanitized-kms.json
```

ben: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/524  changed binding: svc-inference -> kms-decrypt. Approval ticket: JIRA INF-7402 approved by @ben at 2024-11-06T13:40:00Z.

"auditor_rowan": Good. For rotation history, export the key rotation CSV from KMS and list who can rotate (roles/principals). Also show the CMK ARN.

claire: We'll add the KMS key policy JSON and an envelope-encryption diagram. Also include where ephemeral data keys live and TTL.

lila: SIEM rule for trace: SIEM-2024-6120. I'll produce the alert replay (redacted) and show mapping: CC-RBAC-01 -> artifacts/INF-7402/sanitized-kms.json -> proof that role used key.

infra-bot: Reminder: upload evidence to secure bucket s3://redwood-audit-evidence/INF-7402/2024-11-06. Use presigned URLs (48h) and include manifest with SHA256.

ben: For rollback demo we'll capture shell output:
```bash
# before revert (svc-inference role)
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://sample.ct --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999999999999:key/abcd-ef01 --profile svc-inference
# expect: Decryption success
# revert role binding
# after revert
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://sample.ct --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:999999999999:key/abcd-ef01 --profile svc-inference
# expect: AccessDenied (redacted)
```

claire: Timeline: draft bundle by Friday EOD. Owners: ben (runbook + manifest), lila (logs + sanitization + SIEM), claire (bundle assembly + upload). I'll post the presigned link when ready.

"auditor_rowan": If possible, include a short playback script that an auditor can run locally against sanitized snippets. We may request a 30min call to replay.

ben: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:
